clusters.headline: Prabowo Subianto Nominates Amran Sulaiman and Sugiono for VP Roles
aiSummaryBullets: President Prabowo Subianto officially submitted the names of Andi Amran Sulaiman and Sugiono to the MPR for the vice presidential position.
The MPR is currently developing a schedule and procedural steps to verify the academic credentials of both nominees before the December 11 selection.

clusters.headline: Mendagri Tito Karnavian Tekankan Empat Komponen Pertumbuhan Ekonomi
aiSummaryBullets: Minister of Home Affairs Tito Karnavian identified household consumption, government spending, investment, and net exports as four key regional growth drivers.
The ministry aims to strengthen national economic conditions by fostering investment and promoting the export of products from micro, small, and medium enterprises.

clusters.headline: Polri Conducts Ethics Hearing for Brigjen Tedjo in Treason Case
aiSummaryBullets: The Professional and Security Division of the Indonesian National Police held an ethics hearing for Brigjen Tedjo Kusumo.
Brigjen Tedjo and Kombes Iman Imanuddin have been placed in special detention after being named suspects in an alleged treason case.

clusters.headline: Listyo Sigit And Five Suspects Face Treason Case Over Wiretapping
aiSummaryBullets: Former National Police Chief Listyo Sigit and five others have been named as suspects in a treason investigation.
Authorities allege the group conducted illegal wiretapping of President Prabowo Subianto and other high-ranking officials.
